## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also describe testing performed to verify changes.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Hardware / Schematics improvement
- [ ] Host SDK update

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code compiles cleanly targeting `esp32p4` on ESP-IDF v6.1 (if firmware changes).
- [ ] I have tested changes on actual hardware where applicable.
- [ ] I have verified that all relative documentation and asset links work properly.
- [ ] I have followed the code style guidelines described in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
